_about: Land-unit constants for the TerraShield calculator (web + mobile use the same numbers). Every unit is stored as square feet. 'regional: true' means the unit's size differs between districts in Bangladesh; the value here is the commonly used standard, and the app always shows a warning next to it.
_sources: LegalSeba — Land Measurement Systems in Bangladesh: https://legalseba.com/bd-services/land-measurement-system-in-bangladesh/
_notIncluded: Ana-gonda-kora-kranti-til share units are NOT included: the conversion rules could not be verified from a reliable source and the same words are also used as (regional) area units. Kept disabled until verified.

areaUnits.note: Common standard (720 sq ft ≈ 1.65 decimal). Differs in some districts, e.g. Netrokona/Gazipur.
Common standard (20 katha ≈ 33 decimal). Differs widely: ~30 decimal Tangail, 48 Dinajpur, 52 Faridpur, 60 Rangpur, 66 Khulna.
